meta.description: Confirm the competition was run in school according to FOA’s guidelines.

conduct.title: Conduct certification
conduct.lead: Once your students have taken part, one coordinator confirms how the competition was run. It is needed before your school round can be finalised.
conduct.statement: I confirm that {competition} was run at {institution} according to FOA’s guidelines: every student worked alone on their own original work, with the permitted materials and in the time allowed, under a teacher’s supervision, and the entries we submit are theirs.
conduct.certifiedByFormer: Certified on {date} by a coordinator who no longer has an account.
conduct.cannot: You can certify once at least one student’s registration is confirmed.

outcome.certified: Thank you. The competition’s conduct is certified.
outcome.already_certified: Another coordinator has certified it already.
outcome.no_confirmed_students: Certify once at least one student’s registration is confirmed.
outcome.competition_cancelled: This competition was cancelled, so there is nothing to certify.
outcome.forbidden: You no longer act for this institution.
outcome.failed: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again.
